findings.text: the gate log is two lines and its first carries no revision, tree or command, so the recorded 5-passed result cannot be tied to a revision from the run's own receipt; I re-ran the gate at a70ad742 to 5 passed (gate-rerun.log beside this review's manifest) but the receipt itself should carry the provenance the manifest contract names in its first line.

the parity receipt prints the five captured heads but never the imported module's path or the resolved working directory, so "run in place on this node" cannot be confirmed from the log alone and a reader must infer the worktree tree; the manifest's measurement_module names reckon/velocity.py relatively where the field asks for the printed absolute path, so a header line with module.__file__ and cwd would close it for the sections that reuse this measurement.

item_verdicts.diff: read both commits against base 8422a89947718db2f0c4d313d21b964398e6c24f; the module reproduces the census's capture/measure layers with the classifier imported at reckon/velocity.py:41 and no import from docs/, the docs commit appends a landing record and an evidence section without touching plan-version/plan-modified and without resolving any followup, and the figure's numbers match the parity log.
item_verdicts.done_when: every evidence clause is receipted — tests/test_velocity.py:187-230 asserts the promotion split, the six line classes, the seven-day deletion share with its censoring cut and median/p75 on hand-computable fixtures and passes (my re-run at a70ad742: 5 passed, 18.12 s, exit 0); the parity log's five captured heads and window match summary.json's recorded provenance exactly and it ends "rows compared: 74 outside tolerance: 0" including the 830 to 1473 and 85,685 to 62,775 week pair; the manifest cites the reuse map at reports/reckon/s25-coord/s25-reuse-map-review-and-velocity/reuse-map.md, which exists; the negative control log's first line repeats the declared mutation verbatim and shows the predicted censoring failure (mature additions 19 against the fixture's 9).
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to port the velocity census measurement into reckon/velocity.py; the module carries every named layer — capture_project (reckon/velocity.py:219), replay (:449), recover_ledger_clocks (:522), ratio (:643), distribution (:651), measure (:693) and compact_summary (:1234) — behind capture (:1310) and velocity (:1345), which take a caller-named project mapping and window.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the gate result with its log, the parity result with its log, the applied negative control with its red log, the reuse-map citation, and the negative_control_log line is the bare path; its measurement_module names reckon/velocity.py relatively where the contract asks for the printed absolute module path (see the parity finding).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/velocity.py, tests/test_velocity.py, docs/evidence/archive/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity-landed.html, docs/figures/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity and docs/plans/the-fleet-reports-its-velocity.html, and git show --stat for 4d79a470 (velocity.py +1372, tests +230, the parity figure) and a70ad742 (plan +39, evidence record +52/-3) lists those paths and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_velocity.py:207 fails when the censoring cut is dropped, which negative-control.log demonstrates (assert 19 == 9, 1 failed 4 passed), and tests/test_velocity.py:182 fails if the classifier is copied rather than imported.
justifications.evidence: the parity premise verifies independently (parity-check.log:1-5 heads and the window match summary.json's provenance, and its recorded column matches that file's totals on the rows I cross-read), but both the gate and parity receipts lack provenance headers (see findings).
justifications.fit: the module follows the sibling port's idiom at reckon/path_classes.py:1-20 and passes ruff check and ruff format --check on both files, carrying no plan label or tracker reference; the workstation constants at reckon/velocity.py:59-69 are the study's own pins, consistent with existing package practice but a caller-visible default the surfaces node must decide whether to keep.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/velocity.py:1345-1372 exposes velocity(projects, start, end, code_root, run_store_db) and :41 imports file_class and path_class from reckon.path_classes, and the parity measurement reproduces the study's totals and per-project rows on all 74 compared rows.
justifications.scope_discipline: git show --stat for 4d79a470 and a70ad742 lists exactly the five declared write paths — reckon/velocity.py, tests/test_velocity.py, the figure, the plan and the evidence record — and nothing outside them.
